links.outcome: Student ratings of rigor, transparency, reliability, and safety for knowledge-base-constrained vs unconstrained LLM
links.effect: Participants rated the constrained system, whose derivations are limited to a drug-leaflet knowledge base, more highly than unconstrained conversational systems on inferential rigor, transparency, clinical reliability, and perceived safety.
links.quote: Participants consistently rated the constrained system more highly with respect to inferential rigor, transparency, clinical reliability, and perceived safety.
